messages:
Mina: Quick follow-up from the KV shard flapping postmortem. We need clear owners for remediation -> test additions: regression promptset, focused load test, chaos drill that safely triggers shard eviction fallback.

Josh: Splitting immediate vs medium term sounds good. Immediate = promptset to cover the user flows that forced cache regen. Medium = load spike + TTL toggles to surface evictions.

Carla: I can own the promptset. Will pull traces and create 6 seeds: cold-start, long-context, burst-many-short, high-token, streaming edge-case, non-stream path. ETA: end of sprint (Thu).

Sam: I'll take the load harness. Plan: k6 script ramp 100rps -> 2k rps over 10m, include a stage that toggles small TTLs via admin API to simulate eviction. Need the trace window to pick realistic request mix. @Josh can you attach?

Josh: Trace + ops notes: https://redwood.internal/trace/EVT-2026-kv-evict and ticket TICKET-4821 has snapshots.

Mina: Promptset acceptance: should detect regressions in CI. Define regression = >10% tail latency increase OR >2x token generation cost vs baseline. Store prompts in evals/kv-evict/ and wire to nightly.

Carla: Will open PR with prompt metadata + expected outputs and a small local harness. Also adding variants for streaming vs non-streaming since both showed issues.

Sam: Example TTL flip command I'll add to the load job:```
# flip TTL for shard group 7
curl -X POST -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN' \
  https://ops-api.internal/shards/7/ttl -d '{"ttl_seconds":30}'
```
Will make TTL toggle an optional k6 stage.

ops-bot: Created TICKET-4900 "kv-evict: promptset + load + chaos drill" assigned Carla+Sam due 2026-05-14.

QA-bot: Nightly eval job configured: evals/kv-evict runs 03:00 UTC, posts failures to #eng-platform.

Josh: We should run a tabletop and then a live chaos drill next sprint. Tabletop Tue, live Wed. Who leads tabletop?

Carla: I'll draft scenario doc and checklist (prechecks, rollback steps, observability asserts).

Sam: I'll prepare the harness + safe playbook to induce eviction; will include kill-switch and traffic cap.

Josh: I'll update alerts: e.g., sustained cache miss rate >5% for 2m -> page SRE and create monitoring dashboards.

Mina: Owners & deadlines recap: Carla = promptset PR by Thu (TICKET-4901), Sam = load script + TTL stage by next Tue (TICKET-4902), Josh = monitoring + trace links by Mon (TICKET-4903). Tabletop Tue, live drill Wed next sprint.

Carla: Acceptance tests: promptset must fail CI on any model/serving change that increases cold-start token cost >20% vs baseline.

Sam: Load test pass criteria: p95/p99 within baseline threshold under synthetic spike AND token cost < 2x baseline. I'll codify thresholds after baseline run.

Mina: I'll own the post-drill writeup and update the postmortem with links to PRs and lessons learned. Ping me if anything slips.

Josh: Please loop product/solutions for rollout sign-off once PRs land.

Carla: Will ping them in the PR thread.

Mina: Thanks all — keeping thread open until TICKET-4900 moves to In Progress.
